about: Diagrams (.bmap): the diagram editor in the preview, Quick Generate from a node, export as an image, and their settings. Everything about them in the browser lives in this folder; the core only offers extension points. Its settings are declared here ('contributes'), so Shell knows their defaults and shows their fields before any code runs. The file type itself is still one of File types' built-in types (protocol/file-types.json) until it moves here as 'fileTypes'.
name: bmap-diagram

field.label: Auto-pan diagrams to content on open
